note: Copilot & AI #4. Run the screens in order: table, flow, topic, chat (creates VR-0001), row, mcp. Environment DEV (Dataverse); nothing is published and no pay-as-you-go plan is linked. $org and the token are never typed or printed on screen: the org URL comes from the owner's environment variable. A screen that needs a second capture of another kind lists it under 'then'.
prepare: if (-not $env:MG_DV_ORG) { $env:MG_DV_ORG = Read-Host 'Dataverse instance URL of DEV, Settings, Session details (owner types, never shown)' }
# manual (owner, maker portal as labadmin, DEV): solution MGLab Vendor Desk (name MGLabVendorDesk), publisher MG Lab, name mglab, prefix mgl, choice value prefix 72700

# manual (owner, Copilot Studio): reuse or create the agent Contoso Vendor Desk in DEV, turn generative orchestration on, add it to the solution; build the agent flow, topic and the Dataverse MCP tool as described in demo.md Setup 4 to 7 and write down the real wording first
# note: the table is NOT created here, the table screen creates it on camera

screens.name: table
mask: $org and $token are variables: neither value is printed
org URL in any address bar of the follow-up capture

then.name: table-portal
steps: Select environment DEV, then Solutions, then MGLab Vendor Desk
Refresh, open the table Vendor Request, then Columns
Show Request Number (autonumber), Vendor Name, Category, Estimated Annual Cost, Justification, Approval Tier, Status
Pause three seconds
mask: org URL in the address bar and environment picker
tenant name in the top bar

screens.name: agent-flow
steps: Open Contoso Vendor Desk in DEV, Tools, Add tool, Agent flow, Create new
Show the trigger When an agent calls the flow with VendorName, Category, Justification (text), EstimatedAnnualCost (number) and ApprovalTier (text)
Show the Microsoft Dataverse action Add a new row on the Vendor Request table with the fields mapped (Status Submitted, Request Number left empty)
Show Respond to the agent with outputs RequestNumber and a status text; open Settings, Networking and show Asynchronous response OFF
Name the flow Create vendor request and Publish; show the published state
mask: org URL in the address bar

screens.name: topic
steps: Open the agent with generative orchestration on, Topics, Add a topic, From blank, name File a vendor request

Show the trigger description: Use when the user wants to onboard or request a new vendor. Collects vendor name, category, estimated yearly cost and justification, files the request and returns the request number and the approver. Do not use for policy questions.
Show the four inputs (VendorName, Category, EstimatedAnnualCost, Justification) with their descriptions

Show the Set variable value nodes (ValidateRequest and ApprovalTier Power Fx), the Condition on Topic.ValidationError, the Add a tool node for the flow Create vendor request and the output Answer with the ConfirmationMessage formula
Open Code editor for about one second, then close it
mask: org URL in the address bar

screens.name: chat
steps: Open Test your agent in a fresh session
Type: We need to onboard Northwind Print for contract printing, about 4,200 euros a year. We print contracts for clients.
Answer any question the agent asks for a missing value
Show the activity map with the topic and the flow tool call
Show the answer (expected: a request number like VR-0001 and the approver Team lead); keep the real wording if it differs
mask: org URL in the address bar

screens.name: row
mask: org URL is held in $org, never printed

then.name: row-portal
steps: Open Solutions, MGLab Vendor Desk, Vendor Request, Data (table view)
Show the same row: VR-0001, Northwind Print, Printing, 4,200, Team lead, Submitted
mask: org URL in the address bar
tenant name in the top bar

screens.name: mcp
steps: Open the agent, Tools, Add tool, Model Context Protocol, Microsoft Dataverse MCP Server, Add to agent (sign in with a Dataverse connection as labadmin)
Show the tool in the agent's Tools list
In Test your agent type: How many vendor requests have the status Submitted?
Show the real answer and which MCP tool the activity map shows (read_query expected)
If the tool is not offered, show Power Platform admin center, the environment, Settings, Features, Dataverse Model Context Protocol and say so
mask: org URL in the address bar

teardown: # manual (owner): Copilot Studio, delete the agent and the flow Create vendor request; maker portal, delete the solution MGLabVendorDesk and, if nothing else uses it, the publisher mglab; close the browser profile
